activities.title: Concourse C Food Court
activities.pilot_credit: Recommended by First Officer Adam S.
activities.description:
Location: Concourse C Center

Features several quick-service options including Bantam + Biddy, Great Wraps, and Sweet Georgia's Juke Joint. A fantastic setup because it has TVs for sports games and plenty of normal tables to sit and eat comfortably.

activities.title: Concourse F
activities.pilot_credit: Recommended by First Officer Adam S.
activities.description:
Location: Concourse F (International)

The newest and most spacious concourse at ATL. It acts as a phenomenal quiet spot to escape the usual hustle and bustle, especially when the international flights aren't going out.
